mainRelease.title: Libertix 0.3
mainRelease.notes: Adds unattended installation, offline NTFS resize fallback, persistent UEFI boot repair, stronger rollback and post-install verification, safer file sharing, standalone delivery, and expanded automated validation.

distributions.name: Linux Mint 22.3 Cinnamon
distributions.description: Linux Mint is an operating system for desktop and laptop computers. It is designed to work out of the box and comes fully equipped with the apps most people need.

distributions.name: Zorin OS 18.1 Core
distributions.description: Zorin OS Core is a free Ubuntu-based desktop operating system with standard apps and four desktop layouts.

distributions.name: ThoxOS 26.10 Workstation
distributions.description: ThoxOS 26.10 Workstation pairs Ubuntu 26.10 with KDE Plasma 6.7, the ThoxOS emerald dark look and feel, THOX brand typography and the local-first THOX agent stack. Libertix installs it alongside Windows and builds the ThoxOS/Windows dual-boot menu. Source: ttracx/thoxos-ubuntu-26-10 and ttracx/thoxos-desktop.
